motion_rule: the tray never stops: it rolls her down the aisle to 6.45, then he runs it on with her aboard to the last frame; counters, crates and ice sweep across the lens every beat; every action crosses the frame past the lens, never up or down; new shot size each beat, never wider than her head filling a third of frame, one action per beat
character: a plump mackerel with a mirror-striped flank, upright on her tail, jaw working, eye always clear
second_characters: ONE heavy seller in a white cap and stained apron, gold teeth, running from 6.45; ONE buyer, arms only, at 7.85
props: ONE price card reading 3999 in the ice beside her; A SWARM of grey salmon heads under a paper soup pot card; ONE paper bag; ONE fish bone behind his ear
prop_continuity: the heads ride under the soup pot card from 2.15; the bone leaves his ear at 8.90
environment: a fish hall, daylight from the roof, tiled counters and crates packed a fin away both sides, no far wall
light_events: flat white noon off the tiles, a mirror flash down her flank at 3.75, a gold glint at 9.40

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: a smug oily female voice, biting each word, 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: prosh-LI, vre-me-NA, lo-SO-sya, te-PER, ma-YA, O-che-red, blis-TAT, BU-desh, KAZH-doy, KOS-toch-ke
audio.pacing: 0.00-1.90, 2.15-4.25 and 4.50-6.45 each one breath; after 6.45 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her jaw opens wide and shapes every syllable
audio.sfx: ice crunching, trays scraping, crates banging, a scale clanging, a wet guffaw, a wet spit

timeline.a: the tray shoves off, she rears up off the ice, head to the lens
she rides the tray past a crate raking across behind her
her tail whips and hurls the grey salmon heads off the tray at the lens
his forearm rakes the heads across the lens, the card riding them
she shoves the 3999 card upright with her nose
she throws her body over, the tray skidding under her
she drives down the tray on her tail, fins wide, crates banging past
she skids broadside past the lens, light ripping down it
the tray hits a rut, ice jumping up around her
she leans in at the lens, jaw wide, the aisle tearing past
the tray slams through a rut, ice and water sheeting across the lens
the tray flies, she rides its front edge broadside at the lens, crates ripping past
he sweeps across the lens, scoops her into the bag on the move, her head out the top
he slings the bag onto a hook rail and shoves it, bag and fish tearing past the lens
buyer arms sweep across the lens, he swings the bag in and rips the banknotes out past it
he runs on past crates, rams the money inside his apron and guffaws into the lens
running on he whips the bone from his ear across the lens, the hall tearing past
he digs the bone in his gold teeth and spits past the lens; she lunges out of the bag at it, jaw wide

must_appear: the 3999 card beside her to 6.45; at 1.25 her tail hurls the heads off the tray; every line is spoken, the last word by 6.45; he does not touch her before 6.45; from 6.45 the order runs bag, rail, banknotes, apron, guffaw, bone, teeth, spit, one to a beat; her head stays out of the bag, jaw working
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, cyrillic letters, words, scales, a closed jaw while speaking, slow motion, a fish hidden in the bag, a word not in the lines
